description: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Pentacles in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how court cards can be people, aspects of yourself or approaches.
lede: The Pentacles court cards show four practical temperaments, from the learning Page to the experienced King. They can be people, parts of you or approaches.

faces.alt: Four original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row: Page, Knight, Queen and King of Pentacles in order. Each shows its rank and a pentacle icon, with the card name beneath. There are no scenes or published artwork.
faces.caption: The four ranks show four ways of handling the practical world. Ask which one a situation needs and which one comes most naturally to you.
